TaskDescription: The short version of the Berlin Intelligence Structure Test (BIS) comprises fifteen tasks that fully cross the four operation‑related components of intelligence (processing capacity, processing speed, memory, and creativity) with the three content‑related components (verbal, numericalal, and figural). The BIS was administered in groups of up to seven participants.
Instructions: Due to copyright restrictions the full instructions cannot be reproduced here. The Berlin Intelligence Structure Test (BIS) was administered as a paper‑and‑pencil test by a trained experimenter following the BIS manual.
